description: [DEPRECATED compatibility alias - use create_sequence] Create and persist a disabled AI-generated email sequence draft from a goal. The saved draft appears in list_sequences. The name defaults to the goal and the trigger defaults to contact_added; optionally pass listId to scope it. Review before enabling.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

emailCount.description: Number of emails in the sequence (default: 5, max: 10)

goal.description: Goal of the sequence (e.g., 'onboard new SaaS trial users')

listId.description: Optional list ID. When provided, only contacts added to this list trigger the sequence.

name.description: Optional sequence name. Defaults to the goal.

name: generate_sequence

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `generate_sequence` MCP tool.

appUrls.description: Dashboard URLs for relevant Sequenzy resources.

deprecated.description: Always true for this deprecated alias.

deprecationMessage.description: Migration guidance directing callers to create_sequence.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

sequence.description: The persisted AI-generated sequence draft record returned by Sequenzy.

subscriptionUrl.description: Owner-facing subscription, upgrade, and billing-management URL when available.

url.description: Primary dashboard URL for this result.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
